summary: Test verifies archivedChats (computed by filtering real session.isArchived data, not settable directly) is empty and rightPaneMode/isRightPaneOpen update correctly after openRightPane(.archivedChats); production ArchivedChatsPaneView gates ComingSoonPane solely on archivedChats.isEmpty, so the model-level assertion is a faithful 1:1 proxy for the observable empty-state UI outcome. Boundary counterexample (archived chats present) is rejected by the companion non-empty test.
